name: Dumbbell Man Maker
instructions: Start in a high plank with your hands on two dumbbells and your feet wide.
Do a push-up, then row one dumbbell up to your ribs, and row the other.
Jump or step your feet to your hands, then clean the dumbbells to your shoulders and stand.
Press them overhead, lower them, return to the plank, and repeat. Use light weights to start.
